login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Access your personal space.
login.inviteOnly: Registration is by invitation during closed beta. If you were invited, use the link you received.
login.pendingTitle: Finish setting up when you're ready
login.pendingBody: You can continue substance tracking setup, or enter Soma without sharing consumption history. You can change this later from your account.
login.pendingSkipFailed: Could not update your choice. You have not been marked as skipped — try again or enter Soma from the educational pages.
login.statusUnknownTitle: We could not check your setup status
login.statusUnknownBody: Your session is active. You can open Soma’s educational pages now, or retry loading your setup. We will not change tracking until that succeeds.

register.title: Start your journey
register.subtitle: Create your Soma account.
register.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
register.birthDateHint: Used to check that you are 18 or over. Soma stores only the year on the account, not the day or month.
register.closedBeta: Soma is in closed beta. Complete registration with the invitation you received.
register.inviteRequiredBody: Registration currently requires an invitation. Without an invite link, an account cannot be created here.
register.unavailableBody: We could not check whether registration is open. Try again later. Do not assume a sign-up form is available.
register.acceptTerms: I have read the terms of use (development draft, not a published contract).
register.acceptPrivacy: I have read the privacy information (development draft, not a current legal notice).
register.acceptAdultAge: I declare that I am 18 or over. Soma does not ask for an identity document and does not verify this declaration beyond the date of birth and this checkbox.
register.ageRestricted: Soma is aimed at people aged 18 or over.
register.birthDateInvalid: Enter a valid date of birth.
register.acceptRequired: Tick the acceptance boxes to continue.
register.draftNotice: Legal documents are still drafts. Accepting them does not make this a public sign-up for real users.

forgotPassword.title: Recover your access
forgotPassword.subtitle: We'll send instructions to reset your password.
forgotPassword.confirmation: If an account exists for that email, you may receive password reset instructions shortly. Check your inbox and spam folder.

resetPassword.title: Create a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a secure password for your account.
resetPassword.successBody: You can now sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.missingToken: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.
resetPassword.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters

errors.registrationUnavailable: This invitation is invalid or registration is unavailable
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.network: Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
errors.resetFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalidResetToken: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.forgotFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
